stone.base.event.gunther.intro: Oh, good morning ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @! I hope it's not too early... Well, I just wanted to stop by and thank you in person for lending me your evolution stone. I had a call with
stone.base.event.gunther.leave: Well, I should let you get back to your work...
stone.base.specialorder.donate: Deliver the evolution stone in the drop box at the museum counter.
stone.base.specialorder.text: Recent reports suggest that an evolution stone may be hidden among the geodes. If you happen to uncover one, please bring it to me. I'd very much like to examine it.
stone.dawn.event.gunther.research: It seems to be a dawn stone and can be used to evolve Kirlia and Snorunt. Isn't that amazing?!
stone.dawn.event.gunther.return: Oh! I almost forgot! Here is your dawn stone back.
stone.dawn.event.message: You got the 'Dawn stone'! It's been added to your wallet. A gentle energy stirs within you. You've got a deeper understanding of your Pokémon.
stone.dawn.item.description: It gives off a faint, gentle glow that seems almost like morning light. Maybe Gunther can tell you more.
stone.dawn.power.description: Allows you to trigger the evolutions of Kirlia and Snorunt.
